financial.alt: The current Forms show seven rostered staff, two unavailable and four required inside beside a calculated Decision summary. The one-person promotion costs $200; at $40 contribution, five additional guests break even and six exceed it.
financial.caption: Apply the staffing inputs and Calculate. The result supplies operating fit and a conditional financial hurdle; Alex makes the management commitment.

starter.alt: A new street-team analysis has seven rostered staff and zero unavailable. Calculate sits above Forms and YAML, while the Decision summary is pending.
starter.caption: Start analysis preserves the supplied fictional inputs. Set two callouts and Apply inputs to reproduce the first article, then Calculate.

fiveStaff.alt: The native compact calculation finding establishes two fully checked feasible options with five qualified staff available.
fiveStaff.caption: Five available: holding or sending one meets the recorded requirements.

fourStaff.alt: After applying the third callout and recalculating, the native compact finding establishes one fully checked feasible option: holding.
fourStaff.caption: Four available: everyone is needed inside, so only holding meets the requirements.

pending.alt: Three unavailable staff are applied in Forms. The earlier calculation is stale and the Decision summary shows Calculation pending, with Recalculate available above the inputs.
pending.caption: Apply inputs changes the calculation basis. The earlier answer needs recalculation before it can describe the new situation.

thirdCallout.alt: The current Forms show three unavailable staff and the recalculated Decision summary. Only holding is operationally feasible; the inspected one-person plan retains a conditional five-guest financial target.
thirdCallout.caption: Recalculate makes the changed operating answer current. A financial target cannot supply the missing person.

financialReport.alt: Break-even contribution and separate discount-loss inputs appear beside Reports, Expense recovery and the one-person plan’s $200, $40, five-guest and six-guest values.
financialReport.caption: The supporting financial report stays beside its assumptions. These are the original $40 inputs, rather than the illustrative $25 sensitivity row.

comparison.alt: The native financial comparison lists all four promotion plans, additional expense, additional guests to break even and additional guests to exceed break-even.
comparison.caption: The four-plan comparison keeps the financial hurdles together. Its guest counts describe required response, rather than predicted attendance.

excelCoverage.alt: The optional Work with Excel disclosure offers Download Excel and Upload Excel for the installed calculation workflow.
excelCoverage.caption: Excel supplies another route to the same case inputs. Apply the changes, then recalculate.
